BASE_CSS: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lora:ital,wght@1,500&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Caveat:wght@400;700&family=Anton&family=Pacifico&family=Fredoka:wght@400;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400&family=Permanent+Marker&family=DM+Serif+Display&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Archivo+Black&display=block'); * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; } html, body { width: var(--w); height: var(--h); overflow: hidden; } body { font-family: var(--f-corpo), sans-serif; color: var(--texto); background: #fff; position: relative; } .cursiva { font-family: var(--f-cursiva), serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .caixa { text-wrap: balance; font-family: var(--f-titulo); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 1.05; } .foto { background-size: cover; background-position: center; position: relative; } .foto.vazia { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #dfe8f3 0 22px, #e9eff7 22px 44px); } .foto.vazia::after { content: attr(data-falta); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 40px; font: 500 24px var(--f-corpo); color: #6a7c99; } .rodape { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 150px; background: var(--marinho); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 34px; padding: 0 56px; } .rodape img { height: 82px; } .rodape .slogan { color: #fff; font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.35; border-left: 2px solid var(--verdeClaro); padding-left: 30px; } .rodape .slogan b { color: var(--verdeClaro); font-weight: 700; } .icone { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2.5px solid var(--marinho); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; } .icone svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; stroke: var(--marinho); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #fff; border-radius: 18px; padding: 10px 18px; } .foto.vazia { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--marinho), var(--verde)) !important; } .foto.vazia::after { display: none; }
